system.description: A Surveillance Detector is a small, handheld device that scans an area for eavesdropping devices and Surveillance Taggers. When activated, the Surveillance Detector grants a +10 Equipment bonus to Perception checks for locating active or passive Surveillance Devices within 6 squares of the detector. It can be set to either display the presence of eavesdropping or to emit an alarm when such attempts are detected.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue
